messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ああ、何であったかを語ることは、とても困難なことだ この野生で荒々しく、そして厚い森 それは思いの中で恐怖を新たにする！

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG] After the table, list any MISSING or WRONG items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Japanese) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Ahi | Interjection expressing exclamation | ああ | “Ah!” | OK | | quanto | Adverb of degree, intensifies difficulty | とても | “very” | OK | | a | Preposition introducing the infinitive *dir* | — | — | **MISSING** | | dir | Verb (infinitive) “to tell” | 語る | “to tell” | OK | | qual | Interrogative adjective “what” | 何で | “what” | OK | | era | Imperfect of *essere* “was” | あった | “was” | OK | | è | Present copula “is” | だ | “is” | OK | | cosa | Noun “thing” | こと | “thing” | OK | | dura | Adjective “hard / difficult” | 困難な | “difficult” | OK | | esta | Demonstrative adjective “this” | この | “this” | OK | | selva | Noun “forest / wood” | 森 | “forest” | OK | | selvaggia | Adjective “wild” | 野生で | “wild” | OK | | e (1st) | Coordinating conjunction “and” (between *selvaggia* and *aspra*) | そして | “and” | OK | | aspra | Adjective “rough” | 荒々しく | “rough” | OK | | e (2nd) | Coordinating conjunction “and” (between *aspra* and *forte*) | — | — | **MISSING** | | forte | Adjective “dense / strong” | 厚い | “thick / dense” | OK | | che | Relative pronoun “which / that” | それは | “that” | OK | | nel | Preposition + article “in the” | の中で | “in (the)” | OK | | pensier | Noun “thought” | 思い | “thought” | OK | | rinova | Verb “renews” | 新たにする | “renew” | OK | | la | Definite article “the” | — | — | **MISSING** | | paura | Noun “fear” | 恐怖 | “fear” | OK |
### Missing / Problematic Items - **a** – preposition introducing the infinitive is not overtly rendered in Japanese. - **e** (second occurrence) – the second “and” is omitted in the Japanese clause. - **la** – the definite article has no direct counterpart in Japanese.
All other source words are represented correctly in the Japanese translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING or WRONG items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Output per line: Line #, Original Translation, Issues, Corrected Translation (if any). Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

**Line‑by‑line corrections**
| Line # | Original Translation | Issues | Corrected Translation | |--------|----------------------|--------|-----------------------| | 4 | ああ、何であったかを語ることは、とても困難なことだ | Missing the preposition **a** (dative marker before the infinitive) | ああ、何であったかを語ることに、とても困難なことだ | | 5 | この野生で荒々しく、そして厚い森 | Missing the second coordinating **e** (“and”) | この野生で荒々しく、そして、そして厚い森 | | 6 | それは思いの中で恐怖を新たにする！ | Missing the definite article **la** before *paura* | それは思いの中でその恐怖を新たにする！ |
**Final Japanese text**
```text ああ、何であったかを語ることに、とても困難なことだ この野生で荒々しく、そして、そして厚い森 それは思いの中でその恐怖を新たにする！ ```
